stages.description: Raised in the Hage village church with Yuno. Born without magic in a society that ranks human worth by magical power; mocked by nobles and peers. Responds with physical training and an unbroken vow to become Wizard King.
stages.label: Magicless in a magic-ranked world

stages.description: Receives the five-leaf clover grimoire holding the anti-magic devil Liebe when Yuno is attacked at the ceremony. Joins the Black Bulls, the lowest-regarded Magic Knight squad, and finds a found family. Striving gains a channel: missions, tournaments, war.
stages.label: The grimoire and the Bulls

stages.description: Anti-magic awakens fully against Vetto; devil union with Liebe in the Spade Kingdom war. The rage beneath the smile surfaces when striving fails — the optimism has a cost, and the story starts asking what the striving is defending against.
stages.label: The devil's mirror

stages.description: Manga ongoing. The Wizard King bid is unresolved, and the deeper question — who Asta is apart from the title — remains untested. Journey deliberately left open.
stages.label: Unfinished: worth apart from the crown

summary: An inferiority-to-striving arc: a magicless orphan converts rejection into relentless effort, finds a found family, and confronts the cost of his own optimism. Deliberately incomplete — the manga is ongoing.
title: Striving: from magicless orphan to Wizard King bid
